videos.topic: seven shaded on the Day of Judgment
videos.title: 7 People in Allah's Shade
videos.title_en: 7 People Allah Will Shade When There Is No Shade
videos.caption: On a Day with no shade but His, Allah will shade 7 people 🤍 Which one are you working on? Comment 1 to 7 👇

sources.grade: sahih, agreed upon (Bukhari & Muslim); 'His Shade' explained by Ibn Hajar as the shade of His Throne (sunnah.global/hadeeth/en/show/66234)
sources.wording: faithful rendering of the English translation; item 5 phrased as 'refuses an invitation to sin' (the hadith: a woman of status and beauty)

lines.text: On a Day when there is {no shade} but His…
lines.text2: اُس دن جب اُس کے سائے کے سوا {کوئی سایہ} نہ ہوگا…
lines.say: On a Day | when there is no shade but His,

lines.text2: اللہ {سات لوگوں} کو سایہ دے گا۔

lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: a youth raised in the {worship} of Allah,
lines.text2: وہ نوجوان جو اللہ کی {عبادت} میں پلا بڑھا،
lines.say: a youth raised in the worship of Allah,

lines.text: one whose heart is attached to the {mosques},
lines.text2: وہ جس کا دل {مسجدوں} سے جڑا رہے،
lines.say: one whose heart is attached to the mosques,

lines.text: two who {love} each other for Allah’s sake,
lines.text2: دو لوگ جو اللہ کی خاطر ایک دوسرے سے {محبت} کریں،
lines.say: two who love each other | for Allah's sake,

lines.text: a man who refuses an invitation to sin, saying: {I fear Allah},
lines.text2: وہ جو گناہ کی دعوت ٹھکرا کر کہے: {میں اللہ سے ڈرتا ہوں}،
lines.say: a man who refuses an invitation to sin, | saying: I fear Allah,

lines.text: one who gives charity so {secretly} his left hand doesn’t know what his right gave,
lines.text2: وہ جو اتنا {چھپا کر} صدقہ دے کہ بائیں ہاتھ کو خبر نہ ہو کہ دائیں نے کیا دیا،
lines.say: one who gives charity so secretly, | his left hand doesn't know what his right gave,

lines.text: and one who remembers Allah alone, and his {eyes overflow}.
lines.text2: اور وہ جو تنہائی میں اللہ کو یاد کرے اور اُس کی {آنکھیں بہہ پڑیں}۔
lines.say: and one who remembers Allah alone, | and his eyes overflow with tears.

lines.text: That Day, {where} will you be standing?
lines.text2: اُس دن آپ {کہاں} کھڑے ہوں گے؟
lines.say: That Day, | where will you be standing?

lines.text: Which one are you working on? Comment {1 to 7}.
lines.text2: آپ کس پر کام کر رہے ہیں؟ {1 سے 7} لکھیں۔
lines.say: Which one are you working on? | Comment one to seven.
